paper.title: Practical Contextual Bandits with Regression Oracles

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandits with a realizable regression function class F (regression oracle)
unmapped: Realizability: a known predictor class F contains f* with E[r(a)|x,a]=f*(x,a)
Access to a weighted least-squares regression oracle over F
Regret is against the optimal policy pi* = pi_{f*}
settings.definition_quote: Contexts are drawn from an arbitrary space, $x\in\cX$, actions are from a finite set, $a\in\cA\ldef\{1, \ldots, K\}$, ... reward vectors are from a bounded set, $r \in[0,1]^K$ ... There is a predictor $f^{\star}\in\cF$ such that $\En[r(a)\mid{}x,a] = f^{\star}(x, a)$

settings.name_in_paper: Bad instance for confidence-based strategies (lower bound)
settings.definition_quote: Two actions $a_{g}$ and $a_{b}$, so $K=2$. $r_{t}(a_g)=1-\eps$ and $r_{t}(a_b)=0$, regardless of context (there is no noise). $N$ contexts $x^1, \ldots, x^N$.

symbols.G_size: size |G| of the finite base class
symbols.theta_0: disagreement coefficient of F w.r.t. D_X

conditions: product class F = G^A with finite base class G

source.label: thm:disagreement
source.quote: With $\beta_m = \frac{(M-m+1)\concG}{\tau_m - 1}$ and $\concG= 16\log\left(\frac{2|\cG|KT^2}{\delta}\right)$, \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} with \textrm{Option I} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = \tO\left(T^{\frac{3}{4}}\prn*{\log\Abs{\cG}}^{\frac{1}{4}}\sqrt{\theta_0 K}\right).$

results.notes: Regret is realized regret vs pi*, bounded w.p. 1-delta. Õ hides log T, log K, log(1/delta).

symbols.C_delta: complexity term: min of 16 log(2|G|KT^2/delta) and a covering-number bound inf_eps{100 eps T + 320 log(8 E N_1(G,eps,x_{1:T}) K T^2 log T/delta)}

conditions: product class F = G^A (possibly infinite G)

source.label: thm:disagreement_with_massart
source.quote: With $\beta_m = \frac{(M-m+1)\concG}{\tau_m - 1}$ and $\concG$ as in \pref{corr:disagreement_conc}, \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} with \textrm{Option I} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = O\left(T^{\frac{3}{4}}\concG^{\frac{1}{4}}\sqrt{\theta_0 K \log T} + \log(1/\delta)\right).$

results.notes: Full version of Theorem 2, applicable to infinite classes.

conditions: Massart noise condition with margin gamma

source.label: thm:disagreement_with_massart
source.quote: Furthermore, if the Massart noise condition (\pref{def:massart}) is satisfied with parameter $\gamma$, then \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} configured as above with $\delta=1/T$ enjoys an in-expectation regret bound of ... $= O\left(\frac{\theta_0 K^2 C_{1/T} \log^2 T}{\gamma^2}\right)$, which for finite classes is upper bounded by $\tO\left(\frac{\theta_0 K^2\log\prn*{\abs*{\cG}T}}{\gamma^2}\right)$.

results.notes: ERROR CHECK: expression must have gamma**2; see corrected expression: theta_0*K**2*C_1T*log(T)**2/gamma**2. Expected regret against fixed pi* equals pseudo-regret.

symbols.L_20: implicit exploration coefficient L_{2,lambda} at lambda=0
symbols.F_size: size |F| of the finite predictor class

source.label: thm:moment
source.quote: With $\beta_m = \frac{(M-m+1)\concF}{\tau_m - 1}$ where $\concF= 16\log\left(\frac{2|\cF|T^2}{\delta}\right)$, \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} with \textrm{Option II} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = \tO\left(\sqrt{T\consL_{2,0}\log\Abs{\cF}}\right).$

results.notes: Sparse linear corollary in text (Õ(s sqrt(KT log d/psi_min))) not recorded separately.

symbols.C_delta_p: C'_delta from Lemma 9 (min of finite-class log term and covering-number term)

source.label: thm:moment_with_massart
source.quote: With $\beta_m = \frac{(M-m+1)\concF}{\tau_m - 1}$ and $\concF$ as in \pref{lem:disagreement_conc_F}, \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} with \textrm{Option II} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = O\left(\sqrt{T\consL_{2,0}\concF}\log T + \log(1/\delta)\right).$

conditions: Massart noise condition with margin gamma

source.label: thm:moment_with_massart
source.quote: Furthermore, if the Massart noise condition \pref{def:massart} is satisfied with parameter $\gamma$, then \pref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} configured as above with $\delta=1/T$ enjoys an in-expectation regret bound of ... $= O\left(\frac{\consL_{2,0} C'_{1/T} \log^2 T}{\gamma}\right)$

symbols.lambda_m: margin parameter lambda in (0,1) used to tune warm start

tuning: M_0 = 2 + floor(log2(1 + (2M+3) L_1 C'_delta/lambda^2)), lambda in (0,1)

source.label: thm:moment_optimistic
source.quote: With $\beta_m = \frac{(M-m+1)\concF}{\tau_m - 1}$ where $\concF= 16\log\left(\frac{2|\cF|T^2}{\delta}\right)$ and $M_0 = 2 + \left\lfloor \log_2\left(1 + \frac{(2M+3)\consL_1\concF}{\lambda^2}\right) \right\rfloor$ for any $\lambda \in (0,1)$, \pref{alg:regression_ucb_optimistic} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = \tO\left(\frac{\consL_1\log\Abs{\cF}}{\lambda^2} +  \sqrt{T\consL_{2,\lambda}\log\Abs{\cF}}\right).$

results.notes: Algorithm needs L_1 (surprise bound) to set warm start.

source.label: thm:moment_optimistic_with_massart
source.quote: \pref{alg:regression_ucb_optimistic} ensures that with probability at least $1- \delta$, $\reg_T = O\left(\frac{\consL_1 \concF \log T}{\lambda^2} +  \sqrt{T\consL_{2,\lambda}\concF}\log T \right)$

conditions: Massart noise condition with margin gamma

source.label: thm:moment_optimistic_with_massart
source.quote: Furthermore, if the Massart noise condition (\pref{def:massart}) is satisfied with parameter $\gamma$, then \pref{alg:regression_ucb_optimistic} configured as above with $\delta=1/T$ enjoys an expected regret bound of ... $= O\left(\frac{\consL_1 C'_{1/T} \log T}{\lambda^2} + \frac{\consL_{2,\lambda} C'_{1/T} \log^2 T}{\gamma}\ind\{\lambda > \gamma\}\right)$

conditions: Massart noise condition with margin gamma
exists a class with |F| = N+1 and a distribution (K=2, N contexts, no noise)

source.label: prop:lb_optimistic
source.quote: For every $\eps\in(0, 1]$ and $N\in\bbN$ there exists a class of reward predictors with $|\cF| = N+1$ and a distribution for which both Algorithms~\ref{alg:regression_ucb_elim} and~\ref{alg:regression_ucb_optimistic} have regret across $T$ rounds lower bounded by $(1-\eps)\cdot\min\crl*{N, \wt{\Omega}(T)}$.

results.notes: Lower bound applies only to RegCB (both variants), not all algorithms. Probability type not specified; Ω̃ applies only to the T branch.

cited_results.setting_description: Contextual bandits with a finite class F of predictors/policies
